description: This file defines a PHP class 'AdminCategoryEditForm' for handling an administrative form to edit categories within the Goteo platform. It includes form creation, validation, and saving logic, utilizing various model classes and form types.

classes.name: AdminCategoryEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for editing categories in the admin interface, with methods to create, validate, and save form data related to category attributes including name, description, social commitments, footprints, and SDGs.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints ensuring the form fields are not blank where required.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the form with fields for name, description, social commitments, footprints, and SDGs, populating choices from related models.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and persists the form data into the model, updating related associations like SDGs and footprints.
